name: GPT-6 Luna Low/Medium/High/xhigh + GPT-6.1 Sol High · frozen final suite

publication.selection: All selected terminal results use the same frozen suite per corresponding problem, mode, and checkpoint; every selected nonpass is counted once.
display_notes: This release replaces the previous final results for Luna Low, Medium, High, xhigh and Sol High.
The frozen final suite identity is recorded on every measured checkpoint. Policy stops and explicitly inherited agent failures are accounted separately.
The nonpass chart counts each selected checkpoint outcome once; unselected retry failures remain in the attempt audit and do not increase the sample denominator.
Inference cost was not recomputed as part of evaluator-only scoring and is left unknown.
This analysis shows the frozen-suite checkpoint matrix and nonpass distribution. Previous FDR/CC/FC/CPR reports remain attached to their historical analyses and are not reused here.
